test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 13 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Two trains, going in opposite directions, start at the same time from two stations that are 250 km apart. The trains meet each other at a distance of 130 km from one of the stations. Find the ratio of their speeds.
solution:
**GIVEN:**

Distance between two trains (TA and TB) = 250 km

**FORMULA USED:**

Speed is directly proportional to distance,

S₁ / S₂ = D₁ / D₂

**SOLUTION:**

If TA will run 130 km, TB will run 120 km.

If both Trains run at same time then,

S1 / S2 = D1 / D2

SA / SB = 130 / 120

SA / SB = 13 / 12

Hence option 1 is correct answer.
